messages:
heidi: FYI onboarding MistralX-7B int8 run — seeing a small but consistent embedding regression vs our Llama3 baseline on wiki-qa and stack-exchange evals.
omar: numbers?
heidi: avg cosine drop ~0.032 ±0.005 across 3 seeds. not huge but above our regression threshold.
heidi: quick bisect points to a tiny subset of inputs where tokenization differs (compatibility ligatures, roman numerals, superscripts). tokens differ between raw input and NFKC-normalized input.
heidi: example:
```python
# reproducer
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file("models/mistralx/tokenizer.json")
for s in ["Ⅳ history", "IV history"]:
    print(s, t.encode(s).ids)
```
heidi: results showed ids differ for the "Ⅳ" vs "IV" case (e.g. ...1245... vs ...15...).
zu: is this specific to the MistralX tokenizer or our conversion pipeline?
omar: I looked at the convert script — `convert.py` calls `unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s)` in one code path, but our training/embedding pipeline used NFKC. mismatch.
heidi: hypothesis: normalization mismatch -> token id differences -> embedding projection mismatch -> quantization noise amplifies drift. also affects kvcache indexing for longcontext.
omar: simple fix: enforce NFKC everywhere during conversion and add `normalizer` to tokenizer.json explicitly (`{"type": "sequence", "normalizers": [{"type": "nfkc"}]}`) so exported tokenizers are deterministic.
zu: we should add a unit test to onboarding harness: two unicode-equivalent strings (NFC vs NFKC) must map to identical ids after conversion.
ml-ci-bot: CI: started run for PR #4823 (enforce-nfkc-tokenizer). 3/5 checks running.
heidi: also adding an eval patch to compute per-example token-id diffs and fail onboarding if >0.1% of examples differ.
omar: opening PR now, will tag @zu @heidi and eng-runtime (KV-cache folks). ETA: later today.
heidi: note logged in onboarding issue tracker: https://issues.redwood.ai/ONBOARD-789 — includes failing eval artifact: https://ci.redwood.ai/evals/1234 (embedding diffs + sample examples).
zu: nice catch. once PR lands, we'll re-run the int8 baseline and the wiki/eval suite.
heidi: thanks — leaving a short reproducer script in the PR and a proposed migration blurb for customers that pinned older tokenizers. :thumbsup:
